Platypus, shown by a zoologist near the Barwon River, in Geelong (Victoria, Australia)

This illustration by Frederick Polydore Nodder is the first published illustration of a platypus. It accompanied George Shaw's 1799 description of the animal in the Naturalist's Miscellany, or Coloure
